podcast.body: The band recorded a few demos during its short existence but did not produce a full album. "That band only lasted through the summer of 1977 and recorded a few demos, not a full album."

podcast.title: Meeting Andy Summers
podcast.body: While participating in the short-lived Strontium 90, Sting and Stuart Copeland met and played with Andy Summers, a journeyman guitarist whose experience surpassed their own. "But, while they were in the short-lived Strontym90, Sting and Stuart met and played with a journeyman guitarist with more experience than either of them, and a very accomplished resume."

podcast.title: Short-Lived Side Project
podcast.body: Strontium 90 was a side project band that Sting and Stuart Copeland were invited to join, which lasted only through the summer of 1977. "Sting and Stuart Copeland were invited to play in a side project band called Strontym90. That band only lasted through the summer of 1977 and recorded a few demos, not a full album."
